newsitem.title: USA: Stocks give back much gain to end slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Stocks give back much gain to end slightly higher.

text.p: Stocks rose Monday but ended off their highs after an earlier rally fizzled. Fresh economic reports had eased worries about corporate earnings, boosting the market earlier in the session.

According to early, unofficial figures, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 9.25 points to close at 5,882.17, after rising more than 30 points earlier in the session. Advancing issues led declines by a 13-11 margin on the New York Stock Exchange, where trading was moderate at about 386 million shares.
